response.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS overall_avg_modindex
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT ta.telescref,
       ta.avg_modindex,
       ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_avg_modindex AS above_overall_average,
       ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_avg_modindex AS ratio_to_overall_average
FROM telescope_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_avg_modindex
ORDER BY ratio_to_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes with signals but only missing modindex values are excluded because AVG ignores NULL and yields NULL for those groups.
